evidence.title: UIAble - The Complete Shadcn Design System

name: UIAble
summary: Shadcn-based UI system with 779+ components, 393+ blocks, 6 templates and 3 admin dashboards for React and Next.js.
description: A shadcn-based design system for building complete interfaces in React and Next.js: 779+ components, 393+ blocks (bento, hero, pricing, e-commerce, FAQ, feature, footer, gallery, navbar, widgets, charts, tables), 6 templates, 3 admin dashboards, Figma files and Figma/MCP docs. Items are copy-paste or shadcn CLI installable from its registry; the Community tier is free and MIT-licensed, while pro blocks, templates and dashboards come with a one-time Standard purchase ($69, listed at 70% off).
contains: 779+ components, 393+ blocks, 6 templates and 3 admin dashboards
829 ready-to-install items in a shadcn registry
block groups: bento, hero, pricing, e-commerce, FAQ, feature, footer, gallery, navbar, widgets, charts, tables
templates: LMS, finance, AI, portfolio, SaaS, SEO
free Community tier: MIT components and blocks, copy-paste or shadcn CLI install
Standard one-time $69 (listed 70% off) unlocks pro blocks, templates and Figma
Figma files, Figma MCP and docs MCP for agents
built on Base UI primitives, TypeScript, Next.js 16, Tailwind CSS 4 and Motion
